gpt-6-astra._note: OpenRouter model and endpoint catalogs re-verified 2026-09-22: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-6-astra/endpoints; canonical slug openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903. Reasoning is mandatory, with efforts max, xhigh, high, medium and low, and the default is medium. Holds the openai_top seat for the async text and visual councils. No effort pin: the gateway default is medium. The separate Codex apex tier pins high effort.
gpt-6-astra._pricing_note: Cache write is $12.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $20, output is $75, cached input is $2 and cache write is $25 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-6.1-sol._note: Replaces gpt-6-sol. Its one role is the council_default seat. Endpoints verified 2026-09-29 against the OpenRouter catalog: OpenAI and Azure; canonical slug openai/gpt-6.1-sol-20260929. The serving_providers pin keeps every request on the OpenAI host. Reasoning efforts are low, medium, high, xhigh and max, and the default is medium; none and minimal are not supported. This entry pins no effort; gpt-6.1-sol-low is the pinned-LOW alias. Rejects temperature. Chat Completions is supported without tool calling, and the gateway sends no tools. Knowledge cutoff 2026-04-30, from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-6-sol.
gpt-6.1-sol._pricing_note: Cache write is $2.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $4, output is $15, cached input is $0.20 and cache write is $5 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-29 against the OpenRouter model catalog and the OpenAI model page.

gpt-6.1-sol-low._note: Replaces gpt-6-sol-low. Same SKU as gpt-6.1-sol, pinned to LOW reasoning effort, the lowest effort GPT-6.1 Sol supports. No model_roles entry resolves here: the entry exists by owner instruction and is reachable only by naming this key. The gateway emits the pin as the top-level reasoning_effort field. Rejects temperature. Verified 2026-09-29 against the OpenRouter model catalog.
gpt-6.1-sol-low._pricing_note: Cache write is $2.50 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $4, output is $15, cached input is $0.20 and cache write is $5 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-29 against the OpenRouter model catalog and the OpenAI model page.

gpt-6-luna._note: Replaces gpt-5.6-luna. Canonical slug openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922; served by OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock, verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter catalog. Reasoning efforts are none, low, medium, high, xhigh and max, the default is medium, and this entry pins none. Rejects temperature. Chat Completions allows function calling only at reasoning_effort none, and the gateway sends no tools. Knowledge cutoff 2026-05-18. No model_roles entry resolves here: the entry exists by owner instruction. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-5.6-luna.
gpt-6-luna._pricing_note: Cache write is $0.125 per 1M tokens. Above 272000 input tokens, input is $0.20, output is $0.75, cached input is $0.02 and cache write is $0.25 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-image-2.5-sunburst._note: Replaces gpt-image-2, which called the fused SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2. Verified 2026-09-22 against /api/v1/models?output_modalities=image and the model's endpoints; canonical slug openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-20260908. OpenAI serves it on chat completions. Input is text and image. Output is IMAGE ONLY with no text part, whereas the fused SKU returned image and text. No crux role or script names an image entry, and the text callers (call_model, call_gateway, the council seats and /chat) refuse it by type with NotATextModelError, because they return only the reply text: image generation has no crux caller. The entry exists by owner instruction. Reasoning is unsupported and temperature is supported. The capability scores are estimates copied from gpt-image-2.
gpt-image-2.5-sunburst._pricing_note: Image output is $30 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-22 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

claude-fable-5.1._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Pins HIGH effort. The entry is parked with no role by owner decision on 2026-09-28, because a future Fable version is expected to be useful. The council and anthropic_top roles resolve to Opus 5.5.

claude-fable-5.1-medium._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Same API model as claude-fable-5.1, pinned to MEDIUM effort; retained as a parked registry entry after the synchronous council moved to Opus 5.5.

claude-opus-5.5._note: OpenRouter model and endpoint catalogs verified 2026-09-22 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Canonical slug anthropic/claude-opus-5.5-20260921. Reasoning is mandatory; efforts max/xhigh/high/medium/low, default high. Capability scores are copied from the claude-fable-5.1 entry; they are estimates, not Opus 5.5 measurements. Pins HIGH effort for anthropic_balanced. No claude-opus-5.5-medium entry exists — nothing reads it.

claude-opus-5.5-xhigh._note: Same verified Opus 5.5 SKU and Anthropic serving provider as claude-opus-5.5, with XHIGH effort for the council seats, arbiter, and anthropic_top convenience role. The high-effort entry serves anthropic_balanced.

claude-sonnet-5.5._note: OpenRouter model catalog verified 2026-09-28: id anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 (canonical_slug anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5-20260928). The api_string is the id, not the canonical_slug, because the router pins the verbatim OpenRouter listing id. Cache writes are $2.50 per 1M tokens (5 minute) and $4 per 1M tokens (1 hour). The listing's `temperature` support applies only to the two Azure endpoints. The native API rejects a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k with HTTP 400. Sources: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview, fetched 2026-09-28. The release_docs role names it from 2026-09-30 (owner).

gemini-3.1-pro-preview._pricing_note: TIERED: prompts >200k tokens are $4 in / $18 out. Base (<=200k) shown. -customtools endpoint variant available. Source: research/sources/gemini-api-pricing + gemini-3-1-pro-preview.

gemini-3-pro-image-preview._note: OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug (google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview) for both generation and editing, so the former gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit entry is folded in here (PB-0077). Its editing capabilities and per_edit cost are carried over verbatim.

gemini-3.5-flash._note: Frontier-class fast model; sub-agent/agentic-loop workhorse. Source: research/sources/gemini-3-5-flash + gemini-api-pricing.

jev-1.13._note: Structured decision model. Reachable ONLY through the gateway's Decisions route (POST /api/alpha/decisions), NOT through chat completions, so call_model/call_gateway cannot address it; the adapter that can is a development-only experiment and is not part of this distribution. Pinned to 1.13; the latest alias is not a valid route id. Named in no catalog/models.yml alias and in NO model_roles entry, so no agent and no council seat can reach it — crux/scripts/crux/council/council.py resolves seats through model_roles, which is the surface that matters for that claim. Entry read 2026-09-18 from https://openrouter.ai/typesafe/jev-1.13.

performance_tracking._comment: IMPROVEMENT 1: Dynamic adaptation based on actual performance, not static scores

metrics_tracked.success_rate: Per model, per task type success/failure
metrics_tracked.judge_agreement_rate: How often judges agree with human feedback
metrics_tracked.task_type_performance: Model performance breakdown by task classification

model_roles._comment: Single source of truth for default model selection. String roles return one model, list roles return a council.

_changelog: 2026-10-01: 4.2.0. Add a per-entry accepted_served_providers set for the council gate: the gateway-reported provider labels a council seat accepts, matched by exact equality against the reply's top-level provider field. The sets are seeded from the labels the round-1 council record observed, bionic/promptbooks/runs/PB-0136-separate-council-deliberation-from-independent/council/RUN-001-p2-r1.json (votes[].gateway_reported): gpt-6-astra (openai pin) accepts OpenAI, claude-opus-5.5-xhigh (anthropic pin) accepts Anthropic, and gemini-3.1-pro-preview (google-ai-studio pin) accepts Google AI Studio. Only an entry that record observed is seeded. gpt-6.1-sol, claude-fable-5.1 and claude-opus-5.5 were not seated in it, so they declare no set and are not council-eligible; no non-gate caller reads the set. Each label names the host its entry's serving_providers slug names. A seed is complete only when a record the changed council runner writes shows that seat's reported provider in its set. Only a reviewed, committed registry edit changes a set, and the council runner never writes the registry. No role, seat model, weight, effort, serving_providers pin or image entry changes. This is not a model-version fix. | 2026-10-01: 4.1.0. Add a retired_models tombstone list and a per-entry accepted_served_models set for the council gate. The tombstone list names every removed text model key this changelog records. Each set holds the entry's api_string as its one initial member, on the six pinned text entries only; an entry that pins no serving provider declares none. Only a reviewed, committed registry edit changes a set or the tombstone list, and the council runner never writes the registry. No role, seat model, weight, effort or image entry changes. This is not a model-version fix. | 2026-09-30 (owner): re-point release_docs from claude-opus-5.5 to claude-sonnet-5.5, because public-document generation does not need Opus; the two Opus 5.5 entries' notes no longer name release_docs. Sonnet 5.5 rejects a non-default temperature, and its entry is marked supports_temperature false, so the generator's temperature is dropped. No council role, weight or effort pin changes. The registry version is held at 4.0.0 because no key is added or removed. | 4.0.0 (2026-09-29, owner): Register gpt-6.1-sol (pinned to the OpenAI serving provider) and gpt-6.1-sol-low (effort low) from the live OpenRouter catalog, and move council_default[0] to gpt-6.1-sol. gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-sol-low are REMOVED as a deliberate compatibility break; they are never aliased to a GPT-6.1 SKU. GPT-6.1 Sol supports no none or minimal effort, so low is the lowest pin. Cached input is $0.10 per 1M, half of GPT-6 Sol's. gpt-6-luna's _note now lists its own efforts instead of pointing at the removed gpt-6-sol. No council weight changes. The version moves to 4.0.0 because registry keys were removed. | 3.0.0 (2026-09-28, owner): Delete the twelve model_roles entries that no crux code or shipped doc reads: anthropic_fast, openai_chat, council_code, code_review, vision, think_shallow, think_medium, think_deep, plan, reflect, recursive_improve and anthropic_council. council.py's MODEL_WEIGHTS loses its anthropic_council entry. No council member's weight changes. claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5 are REMOVED from the registry as a deliberate compatibility break; they are never aliased, following the 1.5.0 and 1.4.0 precedent. anthropic_balanced moves from claude-opus-5 to claude-opus-5.5, the high-effort Opus 5.5 entry, and call_claude_sonnet still resolves it. The synchronous council's default arbiter now reads council_arbiter instead of anthropic_top. Both roles name claude-opus-5.5-xhigh, so the arbiter's model does not change. The version moves to 3.0.0 because public role names and registry keys were removed. claude-sonnet-5.5 now has no reader and is kept by owner instruction. claude-fable-5.1 is parked with no role by owner decision and is kept because a future Fable version is expected to be useful. Its _note no longer names the deleted think_deep role. | 2026-09-28 (owner, correction): council_code's Anthropic member is claude-opus-5.5, the high-effort Opus 5.5 entry, not claude-opus-5.5-xhigh. | 2026-09-28 (owner): re-point council_code's Anthropic member to claude-opus-5.5-xhigh, matching council_default; anthropic_fast stays on claude-sonnet-5.5. | 2026-09-28: Register claude-sonnet-5.5 from the live OpenRouter catalog and re-point anthropic_fast and council_code's Anthropic member to it. claude-sonnet-5 is kept unchanged and is never aliased to 5.5. call_claude_sonnet still resolves anthropic_balanced, which stays claude-opus-5. No capability scores and no effort pin are added. The registry version is held at 2.1.0 because this patch bumps no version. | 2026-09-25: Move the default async and synchronous Anthropic council seats and arbiter to a scoped Opus 5.5 xhigh entry; repoint anthropic_top and council_arbiter. Keep release_docs on its existing high-effort entry and think_deep on Fable. | 2026-09-22 (GPT-6): Register gpt-6-sol (pinned to the OpenAI serving provider), gpt-6-sol-low (effort low), gpt-6-luna and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst from the live OpenRouter catalog. Move openai_chat, think_medium, council_default[0], council_code[0], vision and recursive_improve[0] to gpt-6-sol. GPT-6 has no Terra, and no role moves to gpt-6-luna. openai_chat, think_medium and the OpenAI members of council_default and council_code now pin the OpenAI host and lose Amazon Bedrock as a fallback. gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-sol-low, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-image-2 are REMOVED as a deliberate compatibility break; they are never aliased to any GPT-6 SKU. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst returns an image with no text part, where the fused gpt-5.4-image-2 SKU returned both. gpt-6-sol-low, gpt-6-luna and gpt-image-2.5-sunburst have no reader and exist by owner instruction. gpt-6-astra is re-verified and openai_top stays on it. No effort pin and no council weight changes. The registry version is held at 2.1.0 because this patch bumps no version. | 2026-09-22: Register anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 ($4/$20 per 1M, high effort, pinned to the Anthropic serving provider) and add the release_docs role, which resolves to it; tools/generate-public-docs.py reads release_docs instead of anthropic_top. anthropic_top, think_deep, council_arbiter, council_default and every council seat and weight are unchanged; no claude-opus-5.5-medium entry is added. | 2026-09-04: Register openai/gpt-6-astra from the live OpenRouter catalog and move openai_top to Astra for async text and visual councils. Preserve the synchronous Terra seat and the separate Sol/low-effort entries. | 2.1.0 (2026-09-03): Upgrade the Fable council seats and shared Fable roles to claude-fable-5.1. Preserve high/medium effort pins. Verify model metadata against the live OpenRouter catalog; cached input is $0.25 per 1M tokens. | 2.0.0 (2026-08-26): OpenRouter is the single inference gateway (PB-0077). providers collapses to one openrouter entry (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, Authorization: Bearer). Every model's provider is openrouter and its api_string is the verbatim OpenRouter id, pinned as-is and never normalized; the bare registry keys are UNCHANGED, so model_roles and every downstream reference need no edit. gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-sol-low pricing corrected to $2/$10 per 1M against the OpenRouter catalog. gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit is FOLDED INTO gemini-3-pro-image-preview (OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug for generation and editing) and gpt-image-2 is re-pointed at the fused SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 (no standalone gpt-image-2 slug exists). claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 keeps its bare key but addresses anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. The three council seats (gpt-5.6-sol, claude-fable-5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview) carry serving_providers, the provider.only allowlist that keeps the seats on three distinct serving hosts. openai_endpoint is DELETED from every entry — the gateway is OpenAI-compatible chat-completions only, and reasoning effort now rides the top-level reasoning_effort field. The eight reader-less blocks (judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, fallback_chains, routing_rules, pipelines, playbook_model_affinity, quality_metrics, recursive_improvement) are DELETED: nothing read them, and re-pinning them under renamed ids would be silent drift. performance_tracking is retained. | 1.5.0 (2026-07-24): Renamed the Anthropic Opus seat claude-opus-4-8 -> claude-opus-5 (Opus 5 released as the drop-in successor; identical $5/$25 per 1M pricing, cached $0.50, 1M context, 128K output, adaptive-only thinking that is now on by default). Every Opus routing seat now points at claude-opus-5: model_roles anthropic_balanced/anthropic_council/code_review/reflect/recursive_improve, judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, fallback chains, and pipelines (complex_refactor/documentation/architecture_decision/creative_generation reviewers). claude-fable-5 remains the flagship tier above Opus, and the sonnet/haiku cost tiers are unchanged. Pricing/context were carried over from Opus 4.8 (which Opus 5 matches) and are flagged for re-verification against a fresh anthropic-models-overview capture. Flagship hierarchy UNCHANGED: claude-fable-5 stays anthropic_top/council_arbiter/think_deep (Opus 5 kept in-place at the balanced/council/review seats). claude-opus-4-8 is REMOVED from the registry entirely — a fallback-only entry plus a `refusal_fallback` mapping were prototyped and then deliberately dropped before release because NO code read them: shipping a declarative-only mapping would have read as a live safety net that did not exist. Anthropic's server-side `fallbacks: "default"` beta is the real mechanism; wiring it is tracked as a follow-on. | 1.4.0 (2026-07-09): GPT-5.6 Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna is now the active OpenAI baseline (per PB-0037/PB-0038). GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-pro active identifiers were INTENTIONALLY REMOVED as part of this baseline switch — a deliberate compatibility break; they are NEVER aliased to any GPT-5.6 SKU. Imported Gemini 3.5 Flash (new model) and corrected Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) metadata/pricing (context_window, max_output_tokens, tiered cost, _pricing_note) from the production line's research-verified corrections (research/sources/gemini-api-pricing, gemini-3-1-pro-preview, gemini-3-5-flash); gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash (text) are retired in favor of these two across judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, and fallback_chains. claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-5 cross-verified against research/sources/anthropic-models-overview (2026-06-12); claude-sonnet-5 max_output_tokens corrected to 64000. GPT-5.6 SKU (Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna) cached_input_per_1m pricing was OMITTED — no authoritative local source exists for GPT-5.6 cache pricing — and each carries a Pricing UNVERIFIED note pending confirmation. claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-medium remain ACTIVE (not disabled) as the Anthropic flagship tier above Opus 4.8. Image models untouched.
